title: Illustrating new understanding of adsorbed water on silica for inducing tetrahedral cobalt(II) for propane dehydrogenation

records.entry_label: Fig. 5a/text: 2 wt% Co/SBA-15 Dir-reduction stability at 600 °C
records.location: Main text p. 8 states Fig. 5a reactivity of H2-reduction and Dir-reduction catalysts with Co content of 2% toward PDH at 600 °C and reports Dir-reduction C3H8 conversion 37% and C3H6 selectivity 96%. Methods p. 10: fixed-bed reactor under atmospheric pressure; 0.4 g catalyst; C3H8 (5 mL/min) and N2 (30 mL/min). Fig. 5a gives stability vs Time (h); final conversion read from last plotted point. Fig. 5b bar labelled 'This work' gives reaction rate; y-axis label 'Reaction rate (mol s^-1 g_Co^-1)'.

records.entry_label: Fig. 5a/text: 2 wt% Co/SBA-15 H2-reduction stability at 600 °C
records.location: Main text p. 8 states Fig. 5a reactivity of H2-reduction and Dir-reduction catalysts with Co content of 2% toward PDH at 600 °C and reports H2-reduction conversion and selectivity as 15 and 92%, respectively. Methods p. 10: fixed-bed reactor under atmospheric pressure; 0.4 g catalyst; C3H8 (5 mL/min) and N2 (30 mL/min). Fig. 5a gives stability vs Time (h); final conversion read from last plotted point.

extraction_notes: Only non-oxidative propane dehydrogenation data measured in the main paper were extracted. Supplementary Fig. 21 and Supplementary Fig. 22 are mentioned in text for 4 and 6 wt% Co and designed samples, but the numerical data/images were not provided in the supplied document, so no records were created for those runs. Literature-comparison bars in Fig. 5b were excluded except the bar labelled 'This work'. Total flow and C3H8 fraction were not calculated because only individual feed flow rates were printed; H2/C3H8 was set to 0 from the stated absence of H2 in the reaction feed.
